g.text: Immutable libmorphism release and public readback
Rust + minimum version + proofs + docs + package
recheck exact tag, lockfile, Rust 1.85, Rocq
create draft only when release is absent
read back immutable=true, tag, assets, checksums
publish only when version is absent
The tag and public version are immutable.
A correction requires a new Cargo version and tag.
